item.text: {"search_note":"I found a few universal or need-based welfare measures, but very little evidence that Putin systematically avoided using welfare and benefits as political tools. The clearest 2024 record points the other way: occupation-linked denial of services, punitive migrant controls, financial restrictions on critics, and broad coercive administration of access and benefits.","evidence":[{"title":"Program of state guarantees for free medical care, 2024-2026","publisher":"Government of Russia","date":"2024-01-09","url":"https://government.ru/docs/all/151778/","summary":"Russia kept a universal free-medical-care program in force, including high-tech and specialized treatment.
